title: EWOH Canonical Work Order Model
description: EWOH 统一工单契约（ADR-012，Phase 6 NO-05e）。工单是维护/质量闭环的 Execution 载体（Event→Outcome）：origin 必填可追溯（maintenance_condition / quality_finding）；subjectEntityId 引用规范身份（ADR-006）；severity 走 Canonical Risk 阶梯（ADR-007）；生命周期 created→scheduled→in_progress→completed→closed（created/scheduled 可取消；in_progress 起不可取消；completed/closed 必须带 completedAt；cancelled 必须带 cancelledReason）。工单不替代 MES 原生工单，MES 工单号仅作 alias（ADR-006）。

transition.const: created→scheduled→in_progress→completed→closed；created/scheduled→cancelled；in_progress 起不可取消；closed/cancelled 终态；其余非法转移拒绝

origin.const: origin={kind∈{maintenance_condition,quality_finding}, id} 必填，工单必须可追溯起源事实

completion.const: status ∈ {completed, closed} 必须带 completedAt，否则拒绝

cancellation.const: status=cancelled 必须带非空 cancelledReason，否则拒绝

severityContract.const: severity 走 Canonical Risk 阶梯（critical/high/medium/low，legacy L1-L3 映射），否则拒绝

rules.transition: created→scheduled→in_progress→completed→closed；created/scheduled→cancelled；in_progress 起不可取消；closed/cancelled 终态；其余非法转移拒绝
rules.origin: origin={kind∈{maintenance_condition,quality_finding}, id} 必填，工单必须可追溯起源事实
rules.completion: status ∈ {completed, closed} 必须带 completedAt，否则拒绝
rules.cancellation: status=cancelled 必须带非空 cancelledReason，否则拒绝
rules.severityContract: severity 走 Canonical Risk 阶梯（critical/high/medium/low，legacy L1-L3 映射），否则拒绝
